question: Should `normalizeMessageActionRequest` become a supported public Plugin SDK channel-action extension point for owner-specific request normalization?
rationale: The patch deliberately expands the public channel adapter and baseline; only the responsible maintainers can decide whether that is the intended permanent plugin contract rather than an implementation-specific workaround.

options.title: Approve the normalization hook
options.body: Keep the producer-boundary design after the Plugin SDK owner confirms this optional hook is an intended supported contract.

options.title: Use a narrower existing seam
options.body: Rework the Telegram repair to avoid adding a new public adapter hook if maintainers do not want owner-specific action normalization in the SDK.
